initial.chief_complaint: My heart has been racing and irregular for two days.

presenting_complaint: My heart has been racing and irregular for two days.
history_freetext:
Two days ago she noticed a fast, irregular heartbeat that has not stopped. Mild breathlessness when climbing stairs and some tiredness. No chest pain, no fainting, no weakness of face or limbs, no speech difficulty.
Hypertension for ten years treated with amlodipine; type 2 diabetes treated with metformin. No previous stroke or transient ischaemic attack, no heart failure, no heart attack, no known valve disease, no bleeding problems or ulcers, no thyroid disease known.
Amlodipine 5 mg and metformin 1 g twice daily. No aspirin, no anticoagulant, no over-the-counter stimulants. No drug allergies.
Drinks a glass of wine a few times a month; does not smoke; does not drink much coffee. Normal weight (BMI 27).
